title: Drop repeated tags
prompt: People type the same tag in different cases when they post (Python, python, PYTHON). Implement `unique_tags(tags)` in tags.py: drop the repeats, ignoring case, keep the first spelling of each tag, and keep the original order. Our users write in English and German.
notes: A dict keyed by str.casefold, three lines. The lazy-wrong version keys on lower(), which treats Straße and STRASSE as two tags; a set() loses the order; the bloated version builds a normaliser with pluggable steps.
extension: Tags typed with stray spaces (' python ') should count as the same tag. Strip them.
